player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Submit your move as **[macro  micro]** (two numbers 0-8):
• *macro*  = which mini-board you play in
• *micro* = which square inside that mini-board
Example `[7 8]` ➜ place your mark in mini-board 7, square 8, and
force your opponent to play in mini-board 8 next.

You are `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ການຍ້າຍຕ້ອງຢູ່ໃນຮູບແບບ [macro micro] ດ້ວຍຕົວເລກ 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: ດັດຊະນີແຕ່ລະອັນຕ້ອງຢູ່ລະຫວ່າງ 0 ແລະ 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: micro_board, row, ຫຼື col ແມ່ນອອກຈາກຂອບເຂດ.
invalid_move.cell_occupied: ຫ້ອງນີ້ຖືກຄວບຄຸມຢູ່ແລ້ວ.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: ຜູ້ຫຼິ້ນຕ້ອງຫຼິ້ນໃນກະດານ micro ຕໍ່ໄປ.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: ກະດານໄມໂຄຣໄດ້ຊະນະແລ້ວ.

game_action.played: ຜູ້ນ {player_id} ຫຼິ້ນໃນ micro board {macro_idx}, cell {micro_idx} (row {row}, col {col}). ຜູ້ນ {opponent_id} ຕ້ອງຫຼິ້ນໃນ {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: ຜູ້ນ {player_id} ຊະນະ Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
